title: ClearAll widget
body: There's currently no ClearAll widget for `react-instantsearch`, do we need one?

comments.body: A widget that will clear both filters and query at the same time ?

> A widget that will clear both filters and query at the same time?

Sorry no, not exactly.

In most implementations we had, we want a ClearAllFilter button. Do we have this today?

(changed the title)

Since the intent of the user should be "I want a ClearAll button" I fear that he will not find this easy to do versus:

``` js
<ClearAll />
```

What do you think?
